queries.query: Matching a destructive technology to a PFAS-rich liquid stream. Prepare a focused review of how electrochemical oxidation, non-thermal plasma, and sonolysis should be matched to a defined PFAS-rich liquid stream.
Compare the reaction environments, feed requirements, and PFAS structures for which each technology has been evaluated.
Assess effects of concentration, salinity, co-contaminants, reactor operation, kinetics, and energy demand.
Translate laboratory, pilot, and field evidence into conditional technology-selection criteria.
